summary: At the monthly permit meeting, {director} sees a planned excavation on a street already booked for paving.
realLife: Oakland brought utility permits and near-term conflicts to a monthly meeting so crews could sequence underground work ahead of resurfacing.
gates: The city manages the affected street and has the project facts described here.
inGame: The city highways budget records the appropriation change. needs: near-term dig permit, paving booking and utility completion date.

turns.pulledBy: The city increases its street appropriation and the following records identify an eligible use: near-term dig permit, paving booking and utility completion date.
turns.what: Move another ready street into the open paving date and rebook the excavated one.

turns.pulledBy: A smaller city appropriation requires the office to revisit the commitment documented by these records: near-term dig permit, paving booking and utility completion date.
turns.what: Hold the conflicting paving order and keep the utility's restoration deadline in the permit.
